purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity VGM Details details.
features: VGM Details Function allows the user to edit the VGM Details.
PR Status must be in "Prepared" status.

events.description: Opens the VGM Details section in the same tab for the selected PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks VGM Details from the single function menu

events.description: Saves the VGM details for the selected PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks Submit after entering all mandatory fields

events.description: Cancels all the input values and requeries the existing data
Shows the VGM history of the selected PR
